newsitem.title: USA: ValuJet resumes more scheduled flights.
newsitem.headline: ValuJet resumes more scheduled flights.

text.p: ValuJet Airlines Inc. said Thursday it restarted scheduled services between Atlanta and Chicago, Philadelphia, Raleigh/Durham, N.C., and Mobile, Ala., the final phase in its plan to fly again.

The discount airline was grounded in June for safety concerns after its Flight 592 crashed into the Florida Everglades, killing all 110 people aboard. On Sept. 26 it announced that it would resume service.
Valujet said it would offer special introductory fares on these routes through Oct. 31.
The airline said it now operated a total of 102 peak daily departures, including flights from Atlanta to Florida, Washington D.C.'s Dulles Airport, Ohio, Georgia, Tennessee and Kentucky.
